description:
A nanosystems engineer has imaged a nanostructured surface using an automated microscope, resulting in a 3x3 grid of overlapping tiles. Your task is to stitch these 9 tiles into a single seamless panoramic image using Fiji's 'Grid/Collection Stitching' plugin.

Tiles are located in `~/Fiji_Data/raw/tiles/` named `tile_1.tif` through `tile_9.tif`. A metadata file `grid_info.txt` in the same directory provides the grid layout parameters (3x3, Right & Down, ~15% overlap).

Steps:
1. Open Plugins > Stitching > Grid/Collection Stitching.
2. Configure the plugin for a 'Grid: row-by-row', order 'Right & Down'.
3. Set Grid size (3x3) and overlap (15%).
4. Select the directory `~/Fiji_Data/raw/tiles/` and use the filename pattern `tile_{i}.tif`.
5. Enable 'Compute overlap' to refine the stitching.
6. Save the fused result as a TIFF file to `~/Fiji_Data/results/stitched/stitched_panorama.tif`.
7. Also save a copy as PNG to `~/Fiji_Data/results/stitched/stitched_panorama.png` for viewing.

The final image should be a coherent reconstruction of the original field of view.
